auth.sms.message: InfoKit code: {code}. It expires in 10 minutes. Never share this code.
auth.email.subject: Your InfoKit sign-in link
auth.email.heading: Sign in to InfoKit
auth.email.body: Use this single-use link to confirm your email address. It expires in 15 minutes.
auth.email.ignore: If you did not request this link, you can ignore this message.
auth.reset.subject: Reset your InfoKit password
auth.reset.heading: Reset your password
auth.reset.body: Use this single-use link to choose a new password. It expires in 1 hour.
auth.reset.ignore: If you did not request a password reset, you can ignore this message; your password stays the same.
invite.subject: {organization} invited you to join InfoKit
invite.heading: You are invited to join {organization}
invite.body: {inviter} added you to the {team} team on InfoKit, the coordination console for aid associations. Sign in with this email address to activate your access.
invite.organizationBody: {inviter} added you to {organization} on InfoKit, the coordination console for aid associations. Sign in with this email address to activate your access.
invite.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this message.
translation.subject: Translate InfoKit content into {language}
translation.heading: A {language} translation has been assigned to you
translation.body: {sender} shared one InfoKit content item with you. The secure page shows only the source text and the {language} translation fields.
translation.ignore: If you were not expecting this request, you can ignore this message.
